hypotheses.justification: Put B = X ⊞ Y, D = Bᘁ and F = tensorRight D. Rigidity supplies tensorRightAdjunction D Dᘁ, so F preserves coproducts and zero morphisms (preservesZeroMorphisms_of_isLeftAdjoint). By preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBinaryCoproduct, isBinaryBilimitOfPreserves and IsBilimit.binary_total, the mapped biproduct satisfies F.map fst ≫ F.map inl + F.map snd ≫ F.map inr = 𝟙 (F.obj B). Insert this identity before F.map f in rightTrace_def. Distributivity of composition from Preadditive C and functoriality split the trace into rightTrace (fst ≫ inl ≫ f) + rightTrace (snd ≫ inr ≫ f), without using rightTrace_add or additive whiskering. Apply rightTrace_comm, which requires no MonoidalPreadditive instance, to obtain the conclusion. This argument uses only the specified biproduct and also covers zero objects, zero morphisms and trivial categories.
